motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the consent agenda, removing item 11.A., Wastewater Treatment Plant Expansion Change Order #5, and placing it as a scheduled item for further discussion, with the change to the minutes as noted, and approving the name Mid Valley Fire Station. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
